title: MARS: Benchmarking the Metaphysical Reasoning Abilities of Language Models with a Multi-task Evaluation Dataset
reasoning: The paper defines 'metaphysical reasoning' as a technical process of reasoning with situational changes in distribution (e.g., highly improbable or abstract events). It explicitly states in Appendix A that it does not explore the philosophical, religious, or ethical dimensions of metaphysics, focusing instead on logical structure and out-of-distribution generalization in LLMs.
